historical_snapshot_policy: Existing 1.0.0 revisions remain immutable and are never silently rewritten as 1.1.0.
new_field_population_policy: New fields begin absent/unknown unless supplied or derived through a versioned permitted rule with provenance; content availability alone never populates Product State.
collection_identity_policy: Repeated components use stable semantic IDs; array position is not identity.
migration_invariants: Schema 1.0.0 snapshots remain immutable and valid historical artifacts.
No new v1.1 field is populated merely because source knowledge exists.
No lower-precedence knowledge overwrites explicit/confirmed/locked user state.
Reference Binding does not mutate Product State by itself.
Visualization Verification does not become Product State.
Presentation parameters remain outside Product State.
Quantitative values are not invented from qualitative language or unscaled imagery.
